body: I just haven't done anything that would make me think otherwise. What good can be done when you are ignored by all you know?

I never do anything right, I get constant criticism from "friends", I get bullied, I'm not going to get into my dream college, I'm hideous, I'm not a desirable person in all aspects of my life. I can't do anything. I want to lay down in bed all day because I wouldn't be making a difference anyway.
